 EAORON TAKES 40 PER CENT OFF SITEWIDE AND ADDS TWO FREE GIFTS FOR BLACK FRIDAY
 Eaoron
 2 mins read
 2 mins read 
 Key Facts: 
 Australian skincare brand EAORON has launched a Black Friday sale offering 40 per cent off sitewide, running until 30 November 2026 at eaoronskincare.com, with no discount code required.
 Australian customers spending over $45 receive free shipping and a complimentary EAORON Sunscreen PRO SPF50+ with their order.
 Every purchase includes a free skincare sample chosen by the customer, with options including various face masks and a Hyaluronic Acid Moisturise Set sample.
 CEO Fernando Rodriguez said the promotion was designed to offer clear, genuine value by pairing a straightforward discount with products customers can use beyond the sale period.
 All offers are subject to availability, and the sale ends on 30 November 2026.
 Australian skincare brand combines sitewide savings, free SPF50+ and a customer-selected sample until 30 November 
 SYDNEY, NSW – 17 November 2026 – Australian-owned skincare brand EAORON has launched a 40 per cent off sitewide Black Friday sale, adding a complimentary Sunscreen PRO SPF50+ to qualifying orders and giving every customer the choice of a free skincare sample.
 Running until 30 November at eaoronskincare.com , the promotion applies the 40 per cent discount automatically at checkout, with no code required. Australian customers who spend over $45 also receive free shipping and one complimentary EAORON Sunscreen PRO SPF50+ per order.
 Every purchase qualifies for one free sample, selected by the customer in their cart before checkout. Options include a single Ageless Tightening Mask, Hyaluronic Acid Glutathione Essence Face Mask, Hyaluronic Acid Moisturise Set sample, Miracle Soothing Mask, Niacinamide Face Mask or NMN Line Filler Mask. Mask samples are one individual mask rather than a full retail box.
 “Beauty shoppers are being presented with an enormous number of Black Friday offers, so the value needs to be clear and genuinely useful,” said Fernando Rodriguez, CEO of EAORON.
 “We have paired a straightforward sitewide saving with products customers can use beyond the sale. The choice of sample lets each shopper trial the formula that interests them, while qualifying orders also receive our Sunscreen PRO SPF50+.”
 The customer-selected sample format gives shoppers greater control over the new product they trial rather than assigning the same gift to every order. For customers building or replenishing a skincare routine, the offer combines an immediate sitewide discount with the opportunity to try another EAORON formula.
 EAORON’s Black Friday sale is now live at eaoronskincare.com and ends on 30 November 2026. The 40 per cent discount requires no code. Free Australian shipping and one complimentary Sunscreen PRO SPF50+ apply to orders over $45, while one free sample is available with any purchase. All offers are subject to availability.
 For more information, visit eaoronskincare.com .
About us: About EAORON:
 EAORON is an Australian-owned skincare brand established in 2014. Its range includes facial serums, masks, moisturisers and sun-protection products sold in Australia, New Zealand and Asian markets.
